name: Tales Nights ~Mukyou no Miko~
original_name: テイルスナイツ ～夢鏡の巫女～
source:
There are a lot of worlds and it's possible to travel between the worlds in dreams. Iphilis is a peaceful world of swords and magic. However, the sealed witch Lamia broke free and summoned demons. Shrine maiden Elysia summons the hero from our world and asks for help. 

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
